landing.title: SplashTrack
landing.foundationNotice: The foundation is in place. There is no functionality yet — the first module follows.
landing.enrolNotice: You have not set up an authenticator yet. Until you do, this account can do nothing else.

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

setup.title: This installation is not set up yet
setup.noAdministrator: There is no administrator yet. Set this installation up with the wizard at /setup. It asks for a one-time token, which you issue from the host — host access is the proof of ownership here:
setup.pendingTitle: Almost there: the administrator still has to set up an authenticator
setup.pendingExplanation: The administrator account exists but has no second factor yet. Until it does, this installation is not set up, and that account can do nothing but sign in and set up its authenticator.
setup.pendingAction: Sign in with the password you chose when the account was created. You are taken to the enrolment page automatically.
setup.pendingSignIn: Sign in and set up your authenticator
setup.noRegistration: There is no self-registration: accounts are created by an administrator.

setupWizard.title: Set up SplashTrack
setupWizard.subtitle: This installation has not been set up yet. Three steps, and then this page closes itself for good.

token.heading: Step 1 — the one-time setup token
token.explanation: Whoever can reach the host owns this installation. The token is in a file on the container's data volume. Read it:
token.whyNotInTheLog: The token is deliberately NOT in the container log. Logs get pasted into public issues, and whoever holds this token becomes the administrator of this installation. So do not paste it anywhere either.
token.label: Setup token
token.help: 32 characters. Dashes, spaces and letter case do not matter.

errors.MISMATCH: That token is not right. Check that you copied the whole value.
errors.EXPIRED: That token has expired. Issue a new one on the host: docker compose exec app splashtrack setup:token --new
errors.ALREADY_USED: That token has already been used. A token works exactly once. Issue a new one: docker compose exec app splashtrack setup:token --new
errors.NO_TOKEN_ISSUED: No token has been issued. Create one on the host: docker compose exec app splashtrack setup:token --new
errors.LOCKED_OUT: Too many failed attempts. Try again in fifteen minutes.
errors.CLOSED: This installation is no longer asking for a token. Reload the page.

administrator.heading: Step 2 — the organisation and the first administrator
administrator.explanation: This runs the database migrations and creates the first administrator. That account gets full control of this installation.
administrator.organizationNameHelp: The name of your swim school or club. It appears throughout the application and you can change it later.
administrator.name: Administrator's name
administrator.passwordHelp: At least {min} characters. Choose something you can remember or that lives in your password manager — there is no email password reset.
administrator.thenMfa: The last step follows immediately: a QR code for your authenticator. This installation is not set up until that second factor is verified.

errors.organisation: Enter an organisation name of at most 120 characters.
errors.email: That is not a valid email address.
errors.emailTaken: An account already exists for that email address.
errors.password: The password must be between 12 and 128 characters.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.closed: This step is no longer available. Reload the page.
errors.failed: Setting up failed. The reason is in the container log: docker compose logs app

enrolment.intro: Step 3 — the last one. Scan the QR code with your authenticator app and enter the six digits. Only then is this installation set up, and /setup closes itself.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.codePrompt: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
signIn.badCredentials: Sign-in failed. Check your email address and password.
signIn.badCode: That code is wrong or has expired.

people.title: People
people.subtitle: People, memberships and pupils. Three separate things — a child can take lessons without being a member, and a member need never swim.

denied.title: No access
denied.explanation: You are not permitted to do this. Required: {permission}. Ask an administrator to extend your role.

errors.denied: You are not permitted to do this.
errors.validation: The submitted details are not valid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.ALREADY_OPEN: This member already has an open membership period. End that one first, so the gap between two periods stays visible.
errors.NOT_OPEN: There is no open membership period to end. Returning starts a new period; a closed period is never reopened.
errors.ENDS_BEFORE_IT_STARTS: A membership period cannot end before it started.
errors.invalidNumber: That number is not usable. It must be 1-32 characters of letters, digits, dot, underscore, slash or hyphen, starting with a letter or a digit.
errors.duplicateNumber: That number is already in use by someone else.
errors.AUTHORITY_REQUIRES_GUARDIAN: Only a guardian relationship may give consent. An emergency contact is someone to telephone, not someone who may consent on a child's behalf.
errors.AUTHORITY_REQUIRES_EVIDENCE: Fill in the evidence when you tick that this person may give consent — record HOW the authority was established.

search.label: Search
search.placeholder: Name, member number or pupil number

fields.dateOfBirthHelp: Leave blank if you do not know it. Never enter a guess: with an unknown date of birth guardian authority lapses automatically and the consent appears in the queue.

membership.numberHelp: Leave blank to allocate one automatically. The member number stays the same, including across a break.
membership.returnHelp: Returning starts a new period. The old period stays, so 'when was this person a member?' remains answerable.

student.numberHelp: Leave blank to allocate one automatically. Separate from the member number: that is a different register.
student.reasonPurpose: A short note about this event. No medical or sensitive information — the medical and pastoral notes exist for that.

relationships.subject: Concerns
relationships.evidencePurpose: Record HOW the relationship was established — for example 'mother, given at registration on 2024-09-01' or 'court order seen on 2025-03-14'. Required if this person may give consent. This field is stored encrypted and every time somebody opens it that is recorded.
relationships.search: Search the other person by name
relationships.searchPlaceholder: Name, member number or student number
relationships.noGuardians: Nobody is recorded as answering for this person.
relationships.noDependants: This person is not recorded as answering for anybody.

evidence.title: Evidence for the relationship
evidence.auditNotice: The fact that you opened this has been recorded in the audit trail, with your name and the moment.
evidence.none: No evidence was recorded for this relationship.
evidence.claimNotice: This is what the school was told and how it was established. It is evidence of a claim, not a legal determination of guardianship.

mfaEnrolment.manualKeyHelp: Choose "enter a setup key" or "manual entry" in your app. Case and spaces do not matter.
mfaEnrolment.backupCodesHelp: Keep these somewhere safe and off this device. Each works once, and they are your only way back if you lose your authenticator.
mfaEnrolment.codeHelp: The six digits your app is showing now.
mfaEnrolment.reloadWarning: Do not reload this page: the QR code disappears and you start again from your password.

groups.title: Groups
groups.subtitle: Who is taught together, who teaches them, and when.

denied.title: No access
denied.explanation: You do not have access to this. The permission required: {permission}. This is not a fault — ask an administrator if you need access.

errors.denied: You do not have access to this action.
errors.validation: The details entered are not valid.
errors.NOT_A_GROUP_MEMBER: This pupil is not an active member of this group. Progress is recorded for a pupil who currently belongs to it.
errors.CRITERION_NOT_ACTIVE: This requirement belongs to a requirement set that is not active. Progress is only recorded against the set currently in force.
errors.groupFull: This group is full. Tick 'place above capacity' if you mean to do this.
errors.sameGroup: That is not a move: the pupil is already in this group.
errors.reasonRequired: Give a reason. Without one, a move later reads as a mistake.
errors.notInSourceGroup: This pupil is not in the group you are moving them out of.
errors.endsBeforeItStarts: The end date falls before the start date.
errors.noOpenInterval: There is nothing open to end.
errors.windowTooWide: Choose a shorter period. More than eighteen months at once is almost always a mistyped year — and running it again is safe.
errors.windowOrder: The end date falls before the start date.
errors.duplicateName: Something by that name already exists. Choose another name.
errors.facilityNotFound: That pool or lane no longer exists.
errors.laneNotInPool: That lane is not in this lesson's pool. Choose a lane in this pool.
errors.laneWithoutPool: Choose a pool first. A lane is inside a pool; without one there is nothing to choose.
errors.laneUnknown: The lanes chosen are not valid.
errors.poolNotFound: That pool no longer exists, or has been taken out of use. Choose another one.
errors.laneOverrideBlocksPool: One or more lessons still to come have lanes of their own. Those lanes are in the current pool, so the series' pool cannot move yet. Return those lessons to following the series first.
errors.SESSION_CANCELLED: That lesson was cancelled; nobody attended it. Record attendance on the lesson that actually took place.
errors.NOT_ON_ROSTER: This pupil is not on this lesson's roster. Add the child first via 'Add guest' below — that covers a make-up lesson, a pupil from another group and a trial swimmer — then record their attendance.
errors.NOTHING_TO_REGISTER: No attendance was supplied; there is nothing to record.
errors.DUPLICATE_PUPIL: The same pupil appears twice in this registration. One lesson, one pupil, one observation — a correction is a separate act.
errors.SUPERSEDED_EVENT_MISMATCH: The observation being corrected does not belong to this lesson and this pupil. A correction always points at the observation it replaces.
errors.CRITERION_SET_NOT_ACTIVE: This criterion set is not active. An aftest is only recorded against the criterion set currently in force.
errors.UNKNOWN_CRITERION: One of the criteria does not belong to the chosen criterion set.
errors.UNKNOWN_GRADE_VALUE: One of the given grades does not exist on the grade scale.
errors.DUPLICATE_CRITERION_RESULT: More than one grade was given for one criterion.
errors.DUPLICATE_CRITERION_WAIVER: More than one waiver was given for one criterion.
errors.DOUBLY_DISPOSED_CRITERION: A criterion was given both a grade and a waiver. Choose one.
errors.INCOMPLETE: Not every criterion was graded or waived. An outcome is never computed over ungraded criteria.
errors.TOO_MANY_ENTRIES: Too many results were submitted at once.
errors.NOT_INDEPENDENT: The assessor is this pupil's own instructor. An aftest that counts toward exam admission is conducted by a different, qualified instructor.
errors.SUPERSEDED_ASSESSMENT_MISMATCH: The aftest being corrected does not belong to this pupil and criterion set.

saved.instructorEnded: Assignment ended. This instructor can no longer see this group.
saved.recurrenceStopped: Recurrence stopped. The lessons it already generated stay.
saved.recurrenceLanes: The series' lanes are saved. Lessons that have already happened keep the lanes they were swum in.
saved.lanesOverridden: This lesson's lanes are changed. This lesson only; the series and every other lesson stay as they were.
saved.lanesCleared: This lesson follows the series' lanes again.
saved.attendanceAmended: Attendance corrected. The earlier observation stays visible in the history.

fields.name: Name
fields.capacityHelp: Places in the group. Leaving it empty means 'not stated', not 'unlimited'.
fields.courseLevelHelp: Which course level this group is taught at. Leaving it empty is fine: it then records nothing, which is not the same as 'beginners'. Note that it also helps decide who may see this group.
fields.courseLevelUnavailable: There are no course levels you may see, so there is nothing to choose here.

detail.title: Group
detail.noMembers: No pupils in this group yet.

instructor.endNote: Ending an assignment is how someone loses access to this group. It takes effect on their very next query — there is no cleanup job. The row stays, so 'who taught this group' remains answerable.

place.title: Place a pupil
place.override: Place above capacity (a deliberate choice, and it is recorded)

move.title: Move a pupil
move.note: One form for every direction. Moving a pupil back down is an ordinary teaching decision and is recorded exactly as moving up is — not as a correction.
move.reasonHelp: The reason is required and is the whole value of the record: 'needs more time on the breaststroke leg kick' is a teaching decision, a blank reads as a mistake.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.subtitle: Lessons for {group}. Times in {timeZone}.
schedule.generated: {created} lessons created out of {planned} planned; {skipped} skipped by a closure.

recurrences.title: Recurrences
recurrences.empty: No recurrence yet. Without one, no schedule can be generated.
recurrences.stopNote: Stopping leaves the lessons it already generated in place; it only stops new ones being added. A lesson that is not going ahead is cancelled on the lesson itself.
recurrences.editNote: The weekday, time, length and pool of the whole series. Lessons still to come move with it; lessons that have already happened stay exactly as they were taught, and a lesson you cancelled stays cancelled.
recurrences.editWindowNote: 'Runs from' and 'runs until' are not fields here. They decide what still gets generated, not what time the lesson is — and moving the weekday carries 'runs from' with it, so there are not two places stating the same thing. A series that should run earlier or longer is a second series.
recurrences.editPoolNote: Another pool clears the series' lanes — a lane is a place inside a pool, so that choice is made again. Lessons that have already happened keep the lanes they were swum in.
recurrences.updated: Recurrence updated. {moved} lesson(s) still to come moved with it; lessons that have already happened are exactly as they were.
recurrences.updatedOnClosure: Note: {onClosure} of those now fall inside a closure. Check them — a lesson that is not going ahead is cancelled on the lesson itself.
recurrences.updatedStartsOn: The series now runs from {date}. The lessons before that stay as the record of what was taught; the series does not create them again.

closures.title: Closures and holidays
closures.note: A closure stops lessons being created. Lessons already on the schedule stay — you cancel those one at a time, each with its own reason.
closures.saveNote: Correcting it changes only what is still to be generated. Lessons that already exist stay; those are cancelled on the lesson itself.

generate.title: Generate the schedule
generate.note: Running this again is safe: existing lessons are not duplicated, and cancelled lessons do not come back.

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.empty: No lessons in this period yet.
lessons.cancelNote: A cancelled lesson stays on the schedule with its reason. 'The lesson was called off' and 'there was no lesson' are different answers to a parent's question.

lanes.title: Lanes
lanes.recurrenceNote: These lanes apply to the whole season. Lessons still to come follow a change automatically; lessons that have already happened keep the lanes they were swum in, and a lesson with a choice of its own keeps it.
lanes.recurrenceNoPool: This series has no pool. Choose a pool first — a lane is inside a pool.
lanes.recurrenceNoLanes: No lanes are recorded in this pool yet. Record them under Pools and lanes.
lanes.sessionNote: A lesson normally follows the series' lanes. Change them here if this week is different — it affects this lesson only.
lanes.sessionClearNote: Drops this lesson's own choice so it follows the series' lanes again.
lanes.sessionNoPool: This lesson has no pool, so there are no lanes to choose.

guest.title: Add guest (make-up lesson, other group or trial swimmer)
guest.note: One mechanism for every child who is not part of this lesson's group: a make-up lesson, a pupil who swims in several groups, or a trial swimmer who is not a member yet (they only need a pupil registration, no membership). The guest does not join the group and takes no place; this lesson's instructor sees the child because they are on this roster, and recording attendance then works normally. A trial swimmer who is not registered as a pupil yet is added via People first.
